entries.value: 中〜高。quad・hash/noise/fbm・uniform・cleanup込みの完結例
entries.reason: L1-316 read. (1) L156 smoothstep(1.25,0.18,length(p)) is the GLSL built-in with edge0>edge1: undefined per ES (parent-saved ES3.0 page; ES1.00 page not fetched); L143 smoothstep(0.30,0.86,...) is ascending, valid. Fix: 1.0-smoothstep(0.18,1.25,length(p)). (2) L268-271 handleResize does not cancel rAF and calls render() with time=0: each resize adds a loop, cleanup stops only the last id, time snaps to 0. (3) premultipliedAlpha:false + blendFunc(SRC_ALPHA,ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA) onto a cleared buffer applies alpha twice; halo/smoke may be darker than intended (use blendFuncSeparate or no blend; render unverified). (4) L51-62 hexToRgb01 handles 3/6-digit hex only; rgb()/oklch()/invalid give NaN. (5) pow(x,y) args valid (x=|d|/width>=0, y>0); hash/noise/fbm standard; 2x5-octave FBM per pixel is heavy.
required_changes: vignette = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.18,1.25,length(p))
Cancel the existing rAF in handleResize, draw with the last timestamp, make cleanup stop all loops
Unify alpha handling (blendFuncSeparate or no blend); verify render (unverified)
Validate colour parsing, fall back to the default
